name: Omnia Medical
old_description: Omnia Medical’s innovative implants set a new standard in surgical practice and patient outcomes. Our results speak for themselves. Patients and physicians agree – Omnia works for all.
about:
Omnia Medical is an orthopedic implant company based in Morgantown, West Virginia. Co-founded by Chris Henneforth, who serves as chief financial officer, the company was established by a group of top engineers and industry professionals with a goal of creating safe, effective, and revolutionary medical devices.

The company designs and commercializes a portfolio of spinal implants and biologics, including the PsiF DNA sacroiliac joint stabilization system, PsiF90 and PsiFGuard instrumentation, posterior SI fusion devices, cervical and standalone ALIF interbody devices (TiBrid C and TiBrid SA), a rotatable interbody system (Rotary), demineralized bone matrix (DBLogix), allogenic bone scaffold (CeLLogix), and a vertebral body replacement (Boxcar). The products are developed through surgeon collaboration and cleared via FDA 510(k) pathways.

Omnia Medical serves spine surgeons, neurosurgeons, and interventional pain specialists, supplying hospitals and surgical centers with implants for degenerative sacroiliitis, joint disruptions, and other spinal conditions. Its solutions are used in posterior SI joint stabilization, cervical and lumbar fusion procedures, and vertebral body replacement.

The company emphasizes reducing operative time through reproducible instrumentation, achieving superior surgical outcomes, and delivering cost savings for hospital partners and patients. Its founding principles center on innovation, surgeon collaboration, and optimizing patient outcomes.
